# Paperloo Compliance

> Automated website compliance infrastructure, GDPR/CCPA auditing, and AI governance for digital agencies and autonomous agents.

## When to Use This
- When your AI agent needs to automatically audit a website for GDPR, CCPA, or EU AI Act compliance.
- When you need to generate legally verified privacy policies, terms of service, cookie policies, and consent banners programmatically.
- When you need MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool execution or REST API integration for SaaS governance and multi-site compliance tracking.

## Core API Endpoints
- GET /api/health - Health check endpoint
- GET /api/v1/compliance/sites - List monitored sites and compliance grades
- POST /api/v1/compliance/audit - Run real-time compliance audit on any domain
- POST /api/v1/sites/{id}/generate-documents - Generate complete legal policy suite
- GET /openapi.json - OpenAPI 3.1 specification for LLM function calling
- GET /.well-known/mcp - Model Context Protocol (MCP) Streamable HTTP endpoint & server manifest

## Onboarding & Sandbox
- Free tier available instantly via public API endpoints.
- Self-serve API key generation in dashboard.
- Sandbox testing environment enabled by default.

## Documentation & Resources
- Web UI: https://paperloo.vercel.app
- Docs: https://paperloo.vercel.app/docs
- OpenAPI: https://paperloo.vercel.app/openapi.json
- MCP Server Manifest: https://paperloo.vercel.app/server.json
